I told Dana in her DM that Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from her own posts in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025. She first wrote 180 seats (amendment signed the day before), then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. She's in that channel, and a seat count is an account detail rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share.

I couldn't see the amendment itself, so I pointed her to June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, if she wants to check the number before it goes in the deck. No approval was needed.
